response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, with a strong background in C++ (including work at National Instruments). However, his recent roles have focused heavily on JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems (Node.js, React) and other languages (D, Java), with limited exposure to modern industrial automation, cloud platforms, or secure development lifecycle practices per IEC 62443. His expertise in C++ is not current or aligned with the role's industrial automation focus.
strengths: Proven C++ experience (e.g., National Instruments, embedded systems)
Strong background in high-performance, low-latency systems (Dlang, async I/O)
Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and domains
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience relevant to industrial automation or cloud platforms
No evidence of work with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or secure development lifecycle (SDL)
Lacks exposure to message brokers, REST/MQTT interfaces, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA)

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation and cloud platform experience
Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and IEC 62443 compliance
